programme.title: Duchess Implacável
programme.desc: Scarlett Monaghan, mais conhecida como Duchess, entra no submundo do contrabando de diamantes, torna-se a líder implacável de um grupo de crime organizado e vai fazer tudo para vingar a morte do homem que amou.

programme.title: Homefront - A Última Defesa
programme.desc: Um ex-agente do departamento de combate à droga muda-se com a filha para uma pequena cidade rural em busca de uma vida tranquila. Quando um conflito escolar expõe o seu passado, ele atrai a atenção de um perigoso traficante local que ameaça a sua família.

programme.title: Bullitt
programme.desc: O tenente Frank Bullitt é um polícia de San Francisco com pouca paciência para as regras, que fará tudo para apanhar o barão do crime que mandou matar a testemunha que estava sob sua proteção.

programme.title: O Uivo
programme.desc: Numa noite de tempestade, o último comboio de Londres trava de emergência numa floresta. O maquinista sai para investigar e desaparece, os passageiros ficam em pânico ao ouvirem uivos vindos da escuridão e há uma criatura à solta que obriga a que todos se juntem para sobreviver.

programme.title: Tom Of Finland
programme.desc: A vida e obra do artista finlandês Touko Valio Laaksonen, mais conhecido como Tom of Finland, uma das figuras mais influentes e celebradas da cultura gay do século XX, desde o seu regresso a casa após lutar na Segunda Guerra Mundial até à sua consagração por via dos seus desenhos homoeróticos.

programme.title: Deep Web
programme.desc: Um documentário que explora os limites da internet e os problemas legais associados à sua liberdade.

programme.title: Rumo À Liberdade
programme.desc: Um pequeno grupo de prisioneiros de várias nacionalidades foge de um gulag na Sibéria em 1940, e atravessa mais de seis mil quilómetros por cinco países hostis para chegar à liberdade na Índia.

programme.title: A Melhor História De Paulo Coelho
programme.desc: Com base em depoimentos do próprio Paulo Coelho, o filme conta a história dos momentos mais marcantes da vida do escritor, como os traumas, a relação com as drogas e a religião, a sexualidade e a parceria com o músico Raul Seixas.

programme.title: K.o.
programme.desc: Antoine Lecomte, um homem frio e arrogante, é o diretor executivo de um canal televisivo. Um dia, ao despertar do estado de coma, descobre que a sua vida mudou e nada parece ser como ele recordava mas será tudo uma realidade ou apenas um sonho

programme.title: Todo O Dinheiro Do Mundo
programme.desc: Quando o neto de 16 anos do homem mais rico do mundo, John Paul Getty, é raptado, a família recebe um pedido de resgate exorbitante, que o milionário se recusa a pagar. Com a vida do filho em jogo, Gail alia-se ao braço direito de Getty para tentar resolver a situação.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Após sobreviver à morte, a assassina contratada Elektra, perita em martes marciais, acaba por ver-se a proteger os seus dois alvos, um pai solteiro e a sua única filha, de um grupo de criminosos sobrenaturais.

programme.title: Torque - A Lei Do Mais Rápido
programme.desc: Um motoqueiro regressa da Tailândia para resolver a relação com a namorada, só que o líder de um gangue quer apanhá-lo para o forçar a devolver duas motos cheias de droga e outro quer matá-lo por lhe ter assassinado o irmão.

programme.title: Regresso Ao Futuro
programme.desc: Marty McFly, um típico jovem americano dos anos 80, aciona acidentalmente uma máquina do tempo construída num DeLorean pelo excêntrico cientista Doc Brown e regressa ao ano de 1955, onde conhece a sua futura mãe, que se apaixona por ele colocando assim em risco a sua própria existência.

programme.title: Hell Or High Water - Custe O Que Custar
programme.desc: Um pai divorciado e seu irmão mais velho, um ex-condenado, recorrem a um plano desesperado de assalto a bancos para salvar a fazenda da sua família no Oeste do Texas.

programme.title: O Capanga Vingança
programme.desc: Pat Tate lança-se numa cruzada para vingar a morte violenta do seu amigo durante um assalto, mergulhando no lado negro do Soho nos anos 90.

programme.title: O Mistério De Jack, O Estripador
programme.desc: Um detetive e um médico legista juntam forças para resolver uma série de crimes horríveis na Londres da época Vitoriana, mas um deles esconde um segredo mortal.

programme.title: Sequestro Nas Montanhas
programme.desc: Um grupo de cinco montanhistas a fazer caminhadas e escaladas nas Terras Altas da Escócia descobre uma menina sérvia enterrada numa pequena câmara numa zona deserta, e vê-se apanhado num aterrorizante jogo de gato e rato com os sequestradores da jovem.

programme.title: O Assassinato De Nicole Brown Simpson
programme.desc: Vinte e cinco anos após a morte de Nicole Brown Simpson, este thriller explora os dias que antecederam o assassinato, com uma nova tese sobre o autor do crime, que se afasta do ex-marido O. J. Simpson e envolve o serial-killer Glen Rogers.

programme.title: O Mauritano
programme.desc: Mohamedou Ould Slahi é detido pelo governo dos EUA logo a seguir ao 11 de Setembro, e é encarcerado em Guantánamo sem julgamento durante anos. Os seus únicos aliados são a advogada de defesa Nancy Hollander e a sua associada Teri Duncan que tentam lutar por justiça e descobrir toda a verdade.

programme.title: Fahrenheit 119
programme.desc: Uma visão cómica e provocadora dos tempos que vivemos, com o realizador Michael Moore a explorar as duas questões cruciais da Era Trump como diabo chegámos aqui e como diabo conseguiremos nós escapar.

programme.title: Desafio Ao Poder
programme.desc: Em 1936, na África do Sul, dez homens são presos por planearem atos de sabotagem e violência contra o governo sul-africano. O advogado Bram Fisher decide assumir a defesa dos detidos. Um dos homens é Nelson Mandela.

programme.title: Regresso Ao Futuro
programme.desc: Marty McFly, um típico jovem americano dos anos 80, aciona acidentalmente uma máquina do tempo construída num DeLorean pelo excêntrico cientista Doc Brown e regressa ao ano de 1955, onde conhece a sua futura mãe, que se apaixona por ele colocando assim em risco a sua própria existência.

programme.title: Os Estagiários
programme.desc: Billy e Nick são vendedores cujas carreiras foram destruídas pela era digital. Na tentativa de provar que não estão obsoletos, conseguem um cobiçado estágio na Google, juntamente com um batalhão de pequenos génios. O problema é que eles são quase info-excluídos

programme.title: Ava
programme.desc: Ava é uma assassina a soldo de uma organização secreta, que viaja por todo mundo com a missão de abater alvos VIP. Quando um desses trabalhos corre mal, Ava é obrigada a lutar pela sua sobrevivência e a enfrentar os fantasmas do passado

programme.title: Moonfall Rota De Colisão
programme.desc: Uma força misteriosa tira a Lua da sua órbita em torno da Terra e envia-a numa rota de colisão capaz de aniquilar a vida como a conhecemos. Semanas antes do impacto, três heróis improváveis vão lançar-se numa última missão no espaço, e descobrem que a nossa Lua não é o que pensávamos que era.

programme.title: Academia De Polícia 2 A Primeira Missão
programme.desc: Os cadetes da Academia de Polícia já se tornaram agentes e é-lhes atribuída a pior esquadra da cidade, onde terão de ajudar o Capitão Pete Lassard a enfrentar o gangue do desvairado Zed.

programme.title: Greenland O Último Refúgio
programme.desc: Uma família luta pela sobrevivência quando um cometa destruidor de planetas chega à Terra. John Garrity, a sua ex-mulher e o seu filho fazem uma perigosa viagem até à sua derradeira esperança de salvação, à medida que a contagem decrescente para o apocalipse global se aproxima do zero.

programme.title: O Torneio
programme.desc: Numa cidade no norte de Inglaterra, um torneio é assistido por dezenas de homens ricos, com 30 concorrentes que estão dispostos a tudo para ganhar um prémio de 10 milhões de dólares. O objetivo é simples matar todos os adversários e ser o último sobrevivente de todos.

programme.title: Força Maior
programme.desc: Uma família sueca goza umas férias num resort dos Alpes Franceses, mas uma avalanche vai provocar o caos durante o almoço num restaurante na montanha, e as reações instintivas do casal vão causar uma fissura que pode provocar o fim da relação.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: The 2019 documentary ‘Approaching the Maelström’ follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass’s composition ‘A Descent into the Maelström’. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway.

programme.title: Puccini - Madama Butterfly
programme.desc: Italian conductor Beatrice Venezi leads the Orchestre national de Metz Grand Est and the Choeur de l'Opéra-Théâtre de Metz Métropole in a performance of Giacomo Puccini’s tragic opera Madama Butterfly (1904). The story revolves around Cio-Cio-San, the young Japanese geisha ‘Butterfly’ who marries the visiting American officer Pinkerton. Faithfully awaiting his return, she cannot accept that Pinkerton has abandoned her.

programme.title: Chopin - Fantaisie in F minor, Op. 49
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Frédéric Chopin’s Fantaisie in F minor, Op. 49. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Haydn, Schubert et al.
programme.desc: Mezzo-soprano Ema Nikolovska (Canada, 1993) and pianist Michael Sikich (United States, 1993) perform ‘The sailor’s song’ from Joseph Haydn’s Six original canzonettas, Book 2 – Hob. XXVIa; Franz Schubert’s Auf dem See, Op. 92 No. 2 (D. 543); ‘Botschaft’ from Johannes Brahms’s Fünf Lieder, Op. 47; ‘Röselein, Röselein!’ from Robert Schumann’s Sechs Gesänge, Op.

programme.title: Copland - Appalachian Spring
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Aaron Copland’s Appalachian Spring Suite. Originally commissioned as a ballet for the legendary dancer Martha Graham, Aaron Copland's Appalachian Spring (1944) has since become an American classic. While first scored for a thirteen-piece ensemble, Copland later arranged the work for a full orchestra.

programme.title: First Snow
programme.desc: One of the first Christmas carols ever written is Perotin the Great’s Salvatoris Hodie. This brilliant 12th century composition, one of the first works ever written for four voices, opens First Snow: the atmospheric Christmas concert by the Brussels Philharmonic.

programme.title: Ravel - Sonata for violin and piano in G major
programme.desc: Japanese violinist Naoya Nishimura and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform Maurice Ravel’s Sonata for violin and piano (No. 2) in G major, M. 77. The sonata consists of three movements. The piece is often listed as “No. 2”, yet the composer wrote his actual second sonata, which remained unpublished until 38 years after his death, before this one. This performance was recorded at the Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally.

programme.title: Chopin - Nocturnes Op. 62
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9, Op. 125
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) and Chorus in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The soloists are Iwona Sobotka (soprano), Anna Stephany (mezzo-soprano), Robert Murray (tenor), and Florian Boesch (baritone).

programme.title: Hans van Manen – Moving to Music
programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. His over 150 ballets all bear his distinct signature, featuring a great clarity in structure, refined simplicity and an aversion to decorative frills.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: American conductor Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in an energetic performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's folk-infused Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17. Written in 1872, the work is nicknamed 'Little Russian' as the composer used several folk tunes from Ukraine, then known as ‘Little Russia’. This performance was recorded at LSO St Luke's, London, on May 31, 2021.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Preludes and fugues
programme.desc: Compagnia Simona Bucci presents an extraordinary concert in scenic form: 'Preludi e Fughe - Geografia antropica'. Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87 inspired choreographer Simona Bucci to take on this project. Seven dancers of Compagnia Simona Bucci dance to Shostakovich’s Preludes and Fugues Nos. 1, 5, 7, 12, 13, 14, 16 and 24, played by Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Romeo And Juliet - Fantasy Ouverture
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink starts with Tchaikovsky's Fantasy Overture from 'Roméo et Juliette'. The second piece by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart is his famous Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major K.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 8, also known as the 'Symphony of a Thousand,' is a monumental choral epic composed in 1906 that requires an enormous ensemble of soloists, choruses, and a massive orchestra to perform its vast musical tapestry. The work is a unique and grandiose tribute to love and the spiritual salvation of mankind, drawing from two distinct textual sources to create its sublime effect.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, maestro Jordan presents Beethoven’s final symphony: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125.

programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name.

programme.title: Berg - Piano Sonata, Op. 1
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Alban Berg’s Piano Sonata in B minor, Op. 1. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano.

programme.title: Dvorák – Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1–8)
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Antonín Dvorák’s spirited Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1-8). These 16 folk dances earned Dvorák, who was a relative newcomer when he wrote them, great success. Originally composed for piano four hands, the London Symphony Orchestra plays the orchestral version of these brilliant works. This performance was recorded at LSO St.

programme.title: Barbara Hannigan at Severance Hall
programme.desc: Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for “Best Classical Solo Vocal Album CRAZY GIRL CRAZY (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) 2018 and took home the Grammy for “Artist of the Year” in 2022. In autumn 2023 she made her long-awaited conducting debut with the Cleveland Orchestra. The programme featured an interesting mix of old and new with Haydn´s Symphony No.

programme.title: Ravel - Ma mère l'Oye
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60. Count Franz von Oppersdorff adored Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 and offered the composer a large sum to write a similar work. Beethoven obliged and completed his Symphony No. 4 in the autumn of 1806.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concertos No. 1 And No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010.

programme.title: Tales of Two Cities: Leipzig-Damascus Coffee House
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. Its musical director is Jeanne Lamon. Together with the Trio Arabica they celebrate the music and culture in the eighteenth century.

programme.title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók’s best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta.

programme.title: Modena - The Belcanto School
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1 And Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. The celebrated pianist performs this signature piece at the Lucerne Festival with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who makes his festival debut with the orchestra. Beethoven’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Sonata No. 13, KV 333
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra in Gustav Mahler’s poignant song cycle ‘Das Lied von der Erde’ (The Song of the Earth). Joining him are two of today's leading vocalists: mezzo-soprano Magdalena Kožená and tenor Andrew Staples. Written in the final years of his life, Mahler’s masterpiece contemplates the beauty of life and the sorrow of parting through some of his most personal and beautiful symphonic writing.

programme.title: Brahms - Tragic Overture in D minor Op. 81
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Symphonies in D by Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig’s Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek’s Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek’s only symphony – was never performed during the composer’s lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke Op. 73
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France.

programme.title: Heavenly Voices - The legacy of Farinelli
programme.desc: The documentary 'Heavenly Voices – The Legacy of Farinelli' (2012) tells us the story of the castrato in music – male singers who were castrated at a young age in order to preserve their high vocal range, a cruel practice that was in place mainly in the 17th and 18th centuries.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Sonata No. 5, KV 283
programme.desc: Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5, KV. 283. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Chamber music by Haydn, Chausson And Mendelssohn
programme.desc: Discover the next generation of chamber music talent from the Reina Sofía School of Music. In the first half of this program, Trio Michelangeli presents two masterpieces: Joseph Haydn’s Piano Trio No. 39 in G major, nicknamed ‘Gypsy’, followed by the romanticism of Ernest Chausson’s Piano Trio in G minor. The concert concludes with a performance by the Erinys Quartet of Felix Mendelssohn’s inventive String Quartet No. 2 in A minor.

programme.title: Teatro Regio behind the scenes
programme.desc: Few Italian theatres can boast of being an absolute point of reference for national and world culture. The Teatro Regio in Turin is both a symbol of excellence in the national operatic tradition and a prestigious stage hosting operas, ballets, concerts, and musicals of great substance.

programme.title: De Falla - El sombrero de tres picos - Suite No. 2
programme.desc: During the New Year’s Gala 2010, the Berlin Philharmonic perform under the baton of Gustavo Dudamel, whose infectious energy and exceptional artistry have made him one of the most sought-after conductors by orchestras and opera companies around the world. They welcome mezzo-soprano Elina Garanca, who has become one of the world’s most famous singers within just a few years.

programme.title: Liszt’s Concerto No. 1 And Mahler’s Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: American ‘Conductor Laureate’ Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra in a program of romantic masterworks. The concert opens with Franz Liszt’s Piano Concerto No. 1, featuring the brilliant Czech pianist Lukáš Vondrácek as soloist. The evening concludes with the emotional journey of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 5. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on May 15, 2022.

programme.title: Schubert - Overture to Rosamunde (D. 644)
programme.desc: Andreas Spering conducts Philharmonie Zuidnederland in a performance of 'Overture Rosamunde' (D. 644), by Franz Schubert (1797-1828). Recorded in Muziekgebouw Eindhoven, the Netherlands in 2015. Schubert initially composed the Overture for Georg Ernst von hofmann's play 'Die Zauberharfe' ('The Magic Harp'), which premiered on August 19, 1820.

programme.title: Toulouse-Lautrec
programme.desc: Dance featured prominently in the work of French artist Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec (1864-1901), painter of Parisian nightlife, entertainment, circuses, and balls. With his ballet ‘Toulouse-Lautrec’, Kader Belarbi, choreographer and director of dance of the Théâtre du Capitole of Toulouse, uses the work of the French artist to craft a new dialogue between painting and dance, impressively reviving the artist and his works.

programme.title: Gara Garayev : Autumn Sonatas
programme.desc: Pianist Vadim Repin and Violist Murad Hüseynov perform Gara Garayev's Violin Sonata and 24 Preludes for Piano. Recorded at La Grange au Lac. Written and directed by Juliette Swierczewski and recorded at La Grange au Lac. Although Garayev is a 20th century composer, his music nonetheless carries allusions to romantic music.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: Conducted by Andreas Spering, the South Netherlands Philharmonic performs Beethoven’s Sixth Symphony. Ludwig van Beethoven painted in his symphony the rustic idylls of a peasants’ picnic in the countryside, rife with murmuring brooks and a frightful thunderstorm. It was destined to become one of his most regularly performed symphonies. In this work too, Beethoven composed with a revolutionary and innovative verve.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 3, Op. 14
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Piano Sonata No. 3 in F minor, Op. 14 (a 'Concerto for piano without orchestra', in the words of music publisher Tobias Haslinger) in 1836. He dedicated it to piano virtuoso Ignaz Moscheles.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Peter and the Wolf
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Sergei Prokofiev’s Peter and the Wolf, Op. 67. Written in 1936, Peter and the Wolf is a short, narrated orchestral suite, telling the story of a brave boy named Peter, who lives with his grandfather on the edge of a forest.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Welser-Möst conducts Farrenc, Ravel And Mussorgsky
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68, also known as the Pastoral Symphony. Beethoven wrote the work upon completion of his Symphony No. 5. Both symphonies premiered at the same legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a performance of Robert Schumann’s Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony’. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann’s four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: J. S. Bach – Christmas Oratorio, BWV 248
programme.desc: Traditionally, many ensembles festively announce the Christmas season with a performance of Johannes Sebastian Bach’s Christmas Oratorio, BWV 248. It consists of six cantatas originally intended for performance on one of the major feast days of the Christmas period. The work saw its first performance in 1734, at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, where Bach occupied the position of cantor.

programme.title: House of Dreams
programme.desc: House of Dreams is an imaginative concert designed by Alison Mackay. The concert is a magical journey to the meeting places of baroque art and music - five European homes where exquisite works by Bach, Handel, Vivaldi, Purcell and Marais were played against a backdrop of paintings by Vermeer, Canaletto, and Watteau. Stage direction by Marshall Pynkoski and narrated by Blair Williams.

programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 5, Op. 47
programme.desc: Maestro Jaap van Zweden conducts the Orchestre de Paris in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 5 in D minor, Op. 47. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, on March 9, 2016.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro: Minas Perdidas T3 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Com um objetivo de 27 onças, a Equipa Turin está de volta à caça quando Jesse Cut chega ao fim. Em Montana, Dave luta para encontrar a próxima mina perdida da equipa.

programme.title: Caçadores De Pedras Preciosas T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: A caminho do acidentado «Top End» da Austrália, JC sugere um desvio que pode ser muito lucrativo. Rod encontra um enorme rubi em Harts Range.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele XL T5 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Uma tempestade brutal fustiga os sobreviventes. Uma grande discussão com Bulent leva Makani a arriscar-se sozinha. É o tudo ou nada na caça da equipa.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele XL T5 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Makani abre caminho para o vale para encontrar uma nova tribo. Ryan traça um plano muito arriscado para caçar uma presa. O calor força um sobrevivente a abandonar o desafio.

programme.title: Chapa E Pintura T9 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Um Camaro de 1969 chega e a equipa confirma que precisa de uma reconstrução completa. O cliente decide dar tudo por tudo com o chassis, o motor e com cada pormenor.

programme.title: Chapa E Pintura T9 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: A construção do Camaro continua, mas a equipa depara-se com um obstáculo quando pretende ligar o motor. Dave tem dúvidas sobre a conjugação das cores.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T24 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: O mundo em que vivemos está cheio de objetos artificiais cuja produção requer uma mecânica sofisticada. Vá aos bastidores das fábricas que fazem a magia acontecer.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T24 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: O mundo em que vivemos está cheio de objetos artificiais cuja produção requer uma mecânica sofisticada. Vá aos bastidores das fábricas que fazem a magia acontecer.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T18 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Mais objetos são vistos ao microscópio enquanto descobrimos como as cordas de ferro industriais, paredes vivas e câmaras de grande formato são feitas.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T11 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Mike compra um supercarro do menu poupança, mais precisamente um puro sangue italiano a menos de 10 mil libras. Mas com os supercarros vêm super despesas.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T11 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Mike encontra um Camaro parcialmente renovado ne Califórnia como a sua quota de problemas. Conseguirá o duo fazer da sua magia e tirar lucro do projeto?

programme.title: Caçadores De Pedras Preciosas T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Inundações, que batem todos os recordes, impedem Rod e JC na primeira etapa da viagem. JC é ensinado a fabricar explosivos e a explorar a mina por lendas locais, os Bomb Kings.

programme.title: Caçadores De Pedras Preciosas T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Rod e JC enfrentam condições meteorológicas difíceis e terrenos íngremes em busca de safiras. Depois, a dupla faz uma grande expedição de pesca: caçar o mítico Tigre-da-Tasmânia.

programme.title: Alasca, A Última Fronteira T2 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Siga os Kilchers e a sua comunidade isolada nos subúrbios de Homer, no Alasca. A família tem cultivado e vivido na sua propriedade há quatro gerações.

programme.title: Alasca, A Última Fronteira T2 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Siga os Kilchers e a sua comunidade isolada nos subúrbios de Homer, no Alasca. A família tem cultivado e vivido na sua propriedade há quatro gerações.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T7 - Ep. 18
programme.desc: Parker muda o Sluicifer para um novo local na esperança de atingir o objetivo de 4,5 milhões de dólares. Problemas com água atingem os Hoffman.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T7 - Ep. 19
programme.desc: Todd explora novos terrenos - mas tudo te o seu preço. Entretanto, Parker está longe do objetivos e o Big red está em sarilhos.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T7 - Ep. 20
programme.desc: Os ambiciosos mineiros estão de volta e mais determinados que nunca. Vivendo isolados na natureza do Yukon, esperam começar uma febre do ouro do século XXI.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T7 - Ep. 21
programme.desc: Enquanto as três equipas lutam pelos seus objetivos, uma discussão na área dos Hoffman termina em demissões - e Parker consegue a maior quantidade de ouro da sua vida.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T11 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são vistos à lupa enquanto descobrimos como são feitos. Neste episódio: binóculos, mini fogo de artifício, botas de borracha e lâminas circulares.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T11 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são vistos à lupa enquanto descobrimos como são feitos. Neste episódio: modelos anatómicos, juke boxes, aperitivos de milho e velas de automóveis.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T11 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são vistos à lupa enquanto descobrimos como são feitos. Neste episódio: lápis, reciclagem de metal e café.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T11 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Mais objetos do dia-a-dia são vistos ao microscópio enquanto descobrimos como são feitos, incluindo dardos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T11 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Saiba como se produz o vidro industrial, máquinas de lavar, baralhos de cartas e arcos e flechas.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T11 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Saiba o que é preciso para produzir câmaras de cinema, decorações de Natal feitas de vidro e pneus gigantes.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T11 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Saiba o que é preciso para produzir microfones, banheiras, relva sintética e canecas de cerveja.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T11 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Saiba o que é preciso para produzir hot rods, ovos decorativos, bicos de mangueiras e bolas de basebol.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T11 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Saiba o que é preciso para produzir acordeões, ananases e articulações artificiais.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T3 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: O escultor Nick e a douradora de molduras Ruth unem-se para restaurar uma mesa antiga muito cara. O estofador Craig tem dificuldade em fixar um design clássico de meados do século.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T3 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Drew desafia um engenheiro a arranjar uma peça dos anos 80, num estado deplorável. O restaurador de globos, James, toma medidas drásticas para restaurar uma obra-prima de 150 anos.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T3 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: O polidor francês, Alex, trabalha com uma velha mesa de bilhar que é difícil de restaurar. Entretanto, Martin assume o desafio de um conjunto raro e valioso de malas Ferrari.

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters T6 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: A cabana isolada de uma família em Mount Vernon não tem cozinha, casa de banho e eletricidade. Conseguirá a equipa melhorar a habitabilidade e preservar o seu charme rústico?

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters T6 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Durante os últimos 30 anos, uma família tem sido proprietária de uma monstruosidade no Lago Cobbosseecontee. Chase e a equipa concordam em salvar esta família.

programme.title: Veterinário Em apuros T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Um cachorro é salvo de um abrigo para abate de animais no Oklahoma. Um cão come uma caixa de chocolates com marijuana e é levado de urgência para a clínica para ser tratado.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele: Desafio Global T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: A lutar pelos seus países e por 200 mil dólares, os concorrentes da Austrália, do Brasil, do México e dos EUA têm de acender uma fogueira primitiva.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele T3 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Os concorrentes têm uma prova de abrigo em cúpula. Laura sofre um traumatismo cervical e Trish tem seiva tóxica no olho. Um sobrevivente sai de maca.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele XL T5 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Uma aliança improvável marca a 1.ª grande prova do desafio da caça e Suzanne exila-se voluntariamente de Seth. Numa missão de caça de 2 dias, predadores mortíferos rodeiam Ryan.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele XL T5 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: O calor abrasador castiga Suzanne que está sozinha. Um possível ataque de uma cobra pode ser a primeira vitória de Seth na luta por comida em África e Bulent enfrenta um lagarto.

programme.title: Chapa E Pintura T9 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Após anos a planear, Dave celebra a abertura da menina dos seus olhos: a Academia Kindig. A equipa apresenta um salão automóvel e tem uma competição amigável.

programme.title: Chapa E Pintura T9 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Um camião velho chega à oficina e Dave sabe que a equipa vai ter um trabalhão. Porém, debaixo de toda a ferrugem esconde-se uma joia.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T11 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Saiba o que é preciso para produzir válvulas gigantes, barógrafos e fraldas descartáveis. E mais, como se enlatam sardinhas?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T18 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Mais objetos quotidianos são vistos ao microscópio enquanto descobrimos como são feitos os blisters dos medicamentos, as fatiadoras e os cataventos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T18 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Chapéus-coco, painéis solares, bolinhos e colunas electroestáticas são vistos ao microscópio.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T11 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Mike investe num automóvel e num barco, tudo num só. Contudo, ele tem alguns problemas de base que podem levar o negócio por água abaixo.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T11 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Vendido como sendo o primeiro carro desportivo de luxo, o Thunderbird vendeu muito bem no seu tempo. Mike procura a edição de '57 que lhe possa dar lucro.

programme.title: Caçadores De Pedras Preciosas T1 - Ep. 3

programme.title: Bayerischer Hof Night Club: Gonzalo Rubalcaba Trio
programme.desc: The Cuban pianist, composer and bandleader Gonzalo Rubalcaba is a star name on today's international jazz scene. Technically dazzling and brilliantly creative, Rubalcaba generates infectious excitement with his music. He says he uses jazz as a reference, but takes in the Cuban and African background which was itself an important influence on jazz musicians in the US.

programme.title: B.B. King: The King of the Blues in Stuttgart
programme.desc: This uptempo, funky performance proves that B.B. King, one of the Masters of the Blues Guitar has still got it. The band features some of today's best blues musicians playing all of B.B. King's classic songs.

programme.title: Blue Note: A Story of Modern Jazz - Part I
programme.desc: Art Blakey, Dexter Gordon, Ron Carter, Herbie Hancock, Thelonious Monk... these names are synonymous with the great Jazz Age. But how many people know Alfred Lion and Francis Wolff, to whom we owe the recorded memory of our Jazz legends? Two German Jews who emigrated from Nazi Germany to New York 'discovered' an American art form which at the time received little serious attention from mainstream America: Jazz Music.

programme.title: Jungle By Night - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned bands. In 2019, one of them is the Amsterdam-based Dutch instrumental collective Jungle by Night. The band plays a mix of various styles, inspired by funk, jazz, dub, rock, and others. The ensemble made its debut in 2010 and has played at numerous festivals.

programme.title: Michiel Borstlap: Blue, Reflective And Frames
programme.desc: Recorded at the Amsterdam Arena during the Amsterdam South East Jazz Festival, Michiel Borstlap tickles the ivories of his Steinway in performances of all his favourite songs on his solo albums ‘Blue’, ‘Reflective’, and ‘Frames’. An unprecedented event: a solo piano concert at the home base of football club Ajax Amsterdam!

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sammy Davis Jr. - Concertgebouw Amsterdam
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 28, 1967, American singer and actor Sammy Davis Jr. appeared at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam for a live, nationwide TV broadcast. Supported by his band conducted by George Rhodes, Davis Jr.

programme.title: Dee Dee Bridgewater: Motherland
programme.desc: Singer Dee Dee Bridgewater walks in with considerable credentials, but this documentary related to her album ‘Red Earth’ trumps them all: Red Earth is a Malian journey that merges and melts all borders. While world-beat listeners will recognize the grooves, this is Bridgewater's first time bringing her own experiences as an African-American woman back to the motherland. It results in a fusion of feeling, visions, and music.

programme.title: NSJ Vocal Selection: Carter, O'Day and Benjamin
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Sunrise
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: Caetano Veloso, Aquele Frevo Axe
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: Münchner Klaviersommer: Eliane Elias Trio
programme.desc: There’s no question about it: with a Grammy for Best Latin Jazz Album for her recording ‘Made In Brazil’, seven previous Grammy nominations, four ‘Gold Disc Awards’, and three ‘Best Vocal Album Awards’ in Japan, Eliane Elias has taken her place in the pantheon of music giants. In her projects, Elias wears many hats: she serves as producer, composer, lyricist, arranger, pianist, and vocalist.

programme.title: Michelle David - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: A Quick Sketch
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Don Cherry's 'Multikulti'
programme.desc: Trumpeter Don Cherry was a musician of great versatility, creating an endless variety of styles and influencing generations of musicians. Multikulti presents a never-before heard mixture of international sounds, from mainstream jazz to reggae, in his first collaboration with the amazing Peter Apfelbaum, one of the most in-demand performers at jazz festivals all over the world.

programme.title: Portrait of Roy Ayers
programme.desc: ‘The legend of the groove’ is a series of documentaries devoted to the musicians who were most influential on contemporary hip hop, soul, rhythm 'n' blues, and on the course of history. Between the late 1950s and now, these musicians radically changed music. Although sometimes hardly in the public eye, they have all been major sources of inspiration for today's major artists: Prince, Erykah Badu, Janis Joplin and Jimi Hendrix.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians.

programme.title: Gil Evans, Ornette Coleman - Schloss Ansbach
programme.desc: This program presents two concerts from Schloss Ansbach in 1978. The first concert features Gil Evans and his orchestra, consisting of Gil Evans on piano, Steve Lacy on soprano saxophone, Arthur Blythe on alto saxophone, Pit Levin on synthesizers, Earl McIntyre on trombone, Lewis Soloff on trumpet, Geoffrey Berlin on bass and Sue Evans on percussion instruments.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Kyle Eastwood Quintet
programme.desc: Bassist Kyle Eastwood (1968) is an explorer, equally at ease with jazz melodies as with pop songs. In the late 1970s, his father Clint took him to see his first jazz concert - a Count Basie performance. Eastwood Jr. was in awe of the drummer and wanted to play an instrument himself. It so happened he wasn’t so much interested in jazz, preferring rhythm and blues, Motown and Stax records, funk groups, and North African and Indian music.

programme.title: MPB Sessions - Thalma de Freitas
programme.desc: Thalma de Freitas is a Brazilian singer, songwriter, and actress from Rio de Janeiro. Daughter of the renowned pianist Laércio de Freitas, her work is a masterful fusion of MPB (Brazilian Popular Music), jazz, and Afro-Brazilian influences. In 2019, her album ‘Sorte!’ was nominated for a Grammy Award. For this intimate performance, she is joined by guitarist Helô Ferreira.

programme.title: The legendary American crooner
programme.desc: His charisma and impeccable phrasing placed him way ahead of the game: ‘The Voice’, Frank Sinatra. The legendary American crooner, who sang swing, jazz, and traditional pop, became one of the most popular and influential musical artists of the 20th century.

programme.title: Mahavishnu Orchestra - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide.

programme.title: Runtown - La Machine de Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Enjoy Runtown’s first concert in Paris, where the Nigerian superstar brings many guests to his show. One of the most talented Nigerian afrobeat scenes will make you rediscover his greatest hits. Nigeria is a very creative country when it comes to the music scene. Runtown is no exception. His first single, “Party Like It’s 1980,” paved the way for “Gallardo,” which caught the entire international scene's attention.

programme.title: Bobby McFerrin - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1988, vocalist Bobby McFerrin appeared at the festival.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: The vibrant island of Malta was in for a night of light and cheerful music when Brazilian music legend João Bosco took the stage on July 21, 2018. The self-taught guitarist made his music debut in the 1970s alongside Elis Regina and Aldir Blanc.

programme.title: Gerry Mulligan Big Band - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, American saxophonist Gerry Mulligan gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: The Blue Note Masters
programme.desc: Ron Carter, Bobby Hutcherson and Joe Chambers are legends of Blue Note Records. They have established themselves as forward-thinking and inventive band leaders, composers and studio musicians, astonishing audiences around the world with their creativity and technical versatility.

programme.title: Tribute to Gilberto Gil - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The series Da Pá Virada sessions presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Caixa Cubo.

programme.title: Jack DeJohnette's Special Edition at Estival 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jack DeJohnette, an important figure in jazz fusion, was inducted into the Modern Drummer Hall of Fame in 2007.

programme.title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham And Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers’ came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career.

programme.title: Omer Avital Qantar - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. Israeli-American double bassist Omer Avital plays radiantly energetic, resounding jazz with oriental influences. At Jazz in Duketown 2019, Avital forms a quintet with saxophonists Asaf Yuria and Alexander Levin, drummer Ofri Nehemya, and pianist Eden Ladin.

programme.title: Time Track
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Modern Jazz Quartet - Live Concert
programme.desc: Formed in 1952 from the rhythm section of Dizzy Gillespie's big band, the Modern Jazz Quartet took its inspiration from classical chamber music as well as jazz's blues roots. The group enjoyed a decades-long career with multiple critically acclaimed albums, cementing their place in the history of the genre.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Marcus Miller
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Germeringer Jazztage: Paco de Lucía And Group
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Orlando Julius
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Sammy Price and the Harlem Beggars
programme.desc: Pianist, singer and civil rights activist Sammy Price is joined by the gospel singers known as the Harlem Beggars for spirited renditions of “Go Tell It on the Mountain,” “I’m a Soldier,” and “When the Saints Go Marching In,” among several others. The group is joined by Wilbert Harrison, who provides accompaniment on organ.

programme.title: The legendary American crooner
programme.desc: His charisma and impeccable phrasing placed him way ahead of the game: ‘The Voice’, Frank Sinatra. The legendary American crooner, who sang swing, jazz, and traditional pop, became one of the most popular and influential musical artists of the 20th century.

programme.title: Liran Donin - Music Meeting
programme.desc: Since 1985, the Dutch city of Nijmegen has been welcoming the International Music Meeting Festival every Pentecost. Ranging from jazz and improvisational music to traditional music and unique crossovers, this adventurous festival is all about musical encounters and international collaborations. In 2019, Tel Aviv-born bass player, producer and composer Liran Donin appeared here.

programme.title: Tyner, Hubbard And Henderson - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences.

programme.title: Soul Eyes
programme.desc: Regarded as the greatest instrumental soloist of all-time, Stanley Gayetzky, famously known as Stan Getz emerged as one of the most significant musical forces in the world of jazz post World War II. With his distinctively warm and lyrical tone, Getz is fondly dubbed as ‘The Sound’ because of his singularity and musical innovations.

programme.title: Rhoda Scott And La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. 'It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.

programme.title: Trio Corrente - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: Da Pá Virada sessions bring the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: R. Brecker, B. Wallace and Band - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Omar Sosa AfroCubano Quarteto
programme.desc: To call Omar Sosa an Afro-Cuban jazz pianist would only capture part of his true style. Because while he has always kept one foot firmly within the traditions of his native isle, this citizen of the world also shows an insatiable curiosity, tirelessly exploring music from around the world: from the Caribbean to India and from West Africa to the Arab World. Nothing seems to escape his thirst for discovery.

programme.title: Tivoli Utrecht: Sven Hammond Soul
programme.desc: Although its music might sound like the sound track of any 1970s American car chase movie, the band Sven Hammond Soul is from the Netherlands. This steaming soul machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ. In April 2012, the band was augmented with vocalist Jenny Lane. Today’s recordings were made at a steaming live performance at Utrecht’s Tivoli in 2012.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Hypnotic Brass Ensemble
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: Spyro Gyra - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, the American jazz fusion band Spyro Gyra took the stage at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Horace Silver - Song for my father
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson’s virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964.

programme.title: 29th Street Saxophone Quartet: Estival 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Boogieball
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Soldier
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet And Rozaa Wortham 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jimmy Witherspoon and Rozaa Wortham, two incredible brilliant jazz musicians. Rozaa Wortham starts off the show with the Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet.

programme.title: Dee Dee Bridgewater: Motherland
programme.desc: Singer Dee Dee Bridgewater walks in with considerable credentials, but this documentary related to her album ‘Red Earth’ trumps them all: Red Earth is a Malian journey that merges and melts all borders. While world-beat listeners will recognize the grooves, this is Bridgewater's first time bringing her own experiences as an African-American woman back to the motherland. It results in a fusion of feeling, visions, and music.

programme.title: The Art Farmer Quartet live In England
programme.desc: Art Farmer: Live in '64?highlights an amazing one-hour concert featuring the great flugelhornist in his prime. Farmer’s band includes legendary guitarist Jim Hall (fresh from Sonny Rollins’ band), drummer Pete LaRoca, and Steve Swallow on bass. The legendary ensemble plays both standards and originals with ease and finesse and highlights why Farmer was considered one of the most innovative horn players in all of jazz.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who was a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: MEGA Fights T1 - Ep. 20
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing, historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features the middleweight championship bout between Sergio 'Maravilla' Martinez (48-2, 27 KOs) and Matthew Macklin aka 'Mack the Knife' (28-3, 19 KOs). The fight took place at Madison Square Garden in New York, NY, USA, on March 17, 2012.

programme.title: FS WCK T2 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Experience the intensity of World Championship Kickboxing with the WCK Muay Thai Rules series, bringing elite international fighters into the spotlight for non-stop action. From explosive knockouts and technical battles to the electrifying atmosphere that has made Muay Thai one of the fastest-growing combat sports in the world, every bout delivers the excitement of world-class kickboxing.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T34 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 1 from Fukuoka, Japan.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior T7 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: The top Ninja Warrior athletes from Europe, Japan, and USA team up to see who can go the fastest or furthest on the ANW7 Las Vegas Finals course. It's Team Europe vs. Team Japan vs. Team USA.

programme.title: FS MMA T5 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: BodogFIGHT features classic MMA matches involving some of your favorite fighters! From Evansville, IN, USA, Dan Hornbuckle and Courtney Ray are ready to rumble. Hornbuckle is a grappling and submission wizard and he will test his skills against the athletic Ray.

programme.title: MEGA Fights T1 - Ep. 34
programme.desc: This episode features a USBA super middleweight title bout that sees Edwin Rodriguez defend against the undefeated Jason Escalera.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights T3 - Ep. 46
programme.desc: Wide World Of Fights includes all styles of fighting from around the world in one show! This episode features a middleweight brawl between top contenders Victor Ortiz and Vivian Harris, as well as kickboxing, sumo, arm wrestling and more!.

programme.title: Judo for the World T1 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode we see the best Judo from the Tokyo Grand Slam where the home nation is looking to dominate as they fielded 7 of Japan's 8 world champions. Plus we catch up with Japan's brother and sister superstars, the Abe's.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 37
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Jhonny Gonzalez defending the WBO bantamweight title against Gerry Penalosa. A left hook to the body ends the fight. Also on the card, a controversial ending to the Nate Campbell / Ali Funeka brawl.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T34 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 2 from Fukuoka, Japan.

programme.title: Pariah: Sonny Liston T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Was Sonny Liston murdered? This four-part documentary series explores the life and untimely death of boxing legend Charles 'Sonny' Liston, who became the heavyweight champion of the world when he knocked out Floyd Patterson in 1962. Unfortunately, just eight years later, he was found dead in his Las Vegas home from an alleged heroin overdose. Suspicion regarding the real cause of his death has continued to this day. Episode 3 of 4.

programme.title: World Karate Federation T2023 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: The highest level of competition in the sport of karate anywhere in the world will take place from Budapest, Hungary, as the WKF SENIOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS take place. The top competitors from across the globe, from six different continents, will all converge on Budapest to stake their claim as the best in the world. Don't miss the WKF SENIOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS, only on FIGHT SPORTS.

programme.title: FIGHT SPORTS MMA T1 - Ep. 146
programme.desc: This episode features a women's banthamweight championship as Amanda 'Mad Dog' Lino and Rizlen 'The Lioness of the Atlas' Zouak fight their way to Fight of the Night honors. Bonus coverage showcases more striking power with Mzawandile Hlongwa vs. Robert Swanepoel and Steve Nwosu vs. Quinton Rossouw. From EFC 70 in Sibaya Casino, Durbin, South Africa on 26-May-2018.

programme.title: Le Comte de Monte Cristo
programme.desc: Lorsque le capitaine du Pharaon meurt en mer, en pleine tempête, Edmond Dantès prend le commandement du navire et le ramène sain et sauf à Marseille. Impressionné, Monsieur Morrel, son employeur, le nomme capitaine. Edmond peut enfin concrétiser ses projets de mariage avec sa bien-aimée Mercédès. Il est alors l'homme le plus heureux du monde. Mais il ignore que sa bonne fortune suscite la jalousie de Danglars, qui convoitait le poste,...

programme.title: Le Comte de Monte Cristo
programme.desc: Après son évasion spectaculaire, Edmond retourne à Marseille, où il découvre la mort de son père et le mariage de Mercédès, désormais installée à Paris. Il rencontre Jacopo, un contrebandier italien qui fuit la police. Tous deux s'échappent et partent pour l'Italie sur le bateau de Jacopo. Après un bref passage en Italie, Edmond prend le bateau de Jacopo et retourne seul sur l’île de Monte-Cristo, où il finit par trouver le trésor....

programme.title: Le Pitch Cinéma
programme.desc: Chaque semaine Le Pitch Cinéma vous présente 5 sorties de la semaine. Rythmé et graphique, une mystérieuse silhouette en contre jour devant un grand écran « donne les clefs aux téléspectateurs pour se forger leur opinion » et décider ensuite d'aller voir les films… ou pas ! Le Pitch Cinéma fait appel à la culture cinématographique des téléspectateurs et propose pour chaque sortie de film un véritable jeu d’association : si vous avez...

programme.title: Visite en Terre Irradiée
programme.desc: Histoires courtes - 'Festival off-Courts : la rentrée des courts à Trouville !' Sophie organise des visites touristiques dans la zone d’exclusion de la centrale nucléaire de Golfech, dans le Tarn-et-Garonne. À la suite de la catastrophe survenue quelques années plus tôt, elle propose aux curieux du monde entier de revêtir une combinaison, de se munir d'un masque et d'un dosimètre, et de parcourir en gyropode ces terres irradiées où...

programme.title: Soleil Pâle
programme.desc: Histoires courtes - 'Festival off-Courts : la rentrée des courts à Trouville !' Sur une plage en été, Abel, 12 ans, a honte du corps de son père, ravagé par le cancer.

programme.title: Ça Commence aujourd'hui
programme.desc: Tous les jours, Faustine BOLLAERT accueille sur le plateau de « Ca commence aujourd’hui » des hommes et des femmes qui viennent témoigner sur une période de leur vie, un drame, une épreuve, un cap à passer ou un changement, et qui font souvent écho à de grands sujets de société. programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 19
programme.desc: Jove enfrenta Alcides para defender Guta, mas evita briga com o peão. José Leôncio decide não interferir na discussão do filho e se decepciona com a reação de Jove. Muda fica aterrorizada ao ouvir o Velho do Rio contar para Juma sobre a morte do jagunço que matou Maria Marruá. Guta enfrenta Tenório. José Leôncio conversa com Jove.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 20
programme.desc: Jove diz a José Leôncio que não tem a intenção de viver no Pantanal. Muda fica aterrorizada ao ouvir o Velho do Rio contar para Juma sobre a morte do jagunço que matou Maria Marruá. José Leôncio se emociona quando Jove pede para Tibério tocar uma música que o avô gostava. Juma ameaça Muda ao vê-la com a espingarda apontada para a onça Marruá. Tadeu leva Jove até a tapera de Juma.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 21
programme.desc: Juma expulsa Tadeu e Jove. José Leôncio pede que Tibério ajude seu filho a perder o medo de cavalo. Jove questiona Tadeu sobre Filó e José Leôncio. Nayara rouba o HD do computador de do ex-namorado. Tenório questiona José Leôncio sobre a lida com bois. Jove leva Guta até a tapera de Juma.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 22
programme.desc: Guta e Jove saem do rio e descobrem que suas roupas foram roubadas. Tibério tenta ensinar Jove a montar. Guta revela para Tenório que se envolveu com o filho de José Leôncio. Jove ouve as reclamações do pai sobre ele e pensa em voltar para o Rio de Janeiro. José Leôncio viaja para São Paulo. Jove decide ir para o ninhal sozinho e Tibério não consegue impedi-lo. José Leôncio discute com Tadeu.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 23
programme.desc: José Leôncio pensa em como dará a notícia para ex-mulher. Madeleine discute com Mariana sobre Gustavo. Tibério vai com Levi à tapera de Juma. O Velho do Rio deixa Jove aos cuidados de Juma. José Leôncio vai ao Rio de Janeiro falar com Madeleine. Guta chega à tapera de Juma e pergunta por Jove. Tibério vai embora da fazenda. José Leôncio chega à mansão dos Novaes.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 24
programme.desc: Gustavo discute com Madeleine e vai embora. O Velho do Rio pede ajuda a Juma. O Velho do Rio faz seu ritual na tapera de Juma. José Leôncio e os peões procuram por Jove pelas matas. O fazendeiro culpa Tibério por ter permitido que seu filho saísse sozinho de barco e demite o peão. Juma cuida de Jove e teme pela sua morte. José Leôncio pensa em como dará a notícia para ex-mulher.

programme.title: Câncer com Ascendente em Virgem
programme.desc: Clara precisa confrontar seu estilo de vida acelerado e personalidade controladora quando é surpreendida pelo diagnóstico de câncer de mama.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 102
programme.desc: Nos anos 1920, Rafael e Luna se apaixonam. Assassinada a mando da invejosa Cristina, Luna reencarna como Serena e novamente se apaixona por Rafael, confirmando o amor eterno.

programme.title: Orgulho E Paixão - Ep. 91
programme.desc: Susana ataca Briana e todos se surpreendem. Julieta revela a Jane o trabalho de Camilo. Tibúrcio não aceita que Josephine fique na mansão, e Edmundo e Rômulo contrariam o pai. Mariana decide revelar seu disfarce a Brandão. Lídia procura Rômulo. Elisabeta encoraja Briana a enfrentar a mãe. O Barão pede asilo na casa de Brandão. Jane descobre o segredo de Camilo, mas acaba ameaçada por um homem.

programme.desc: Fábio pede união a todos para que consigam sair da ilha. Édson esconde algum segredo. Horácio decide agir para encontrar os desaparecidos. Jô se desespera com as últimas notícias.

programme.title: Império - Ep. 150
programme.desc: José Pedro é preso após denúncia anônima de Maurílio. Enrico arma para acabar com a festa organizada pelo pai. Elivaldo encontra José Alfredo. Maurílio pede Marta em casamento.

programme.title: Passione - Ep. 138
programme.desc: Diogo disfarça para justificar a visita e Totó fica cismado. Stela não conta sobre Fred para Bete, que percebe que ela esconde alguma coisa. Antero resolve contar a verdade para Brígida. Jéssica e Agostina são presas. Mauro avisa a Noronha que vai denunciá-lo à polícia se ele não contar onde está o dinheiro que foi roubado da metalúrgica. Noronha comenta com Laura que vai ter que dar um jeito para parar com a investigação de Mauro.

programme.title: A Nobreza do Amor - Ep. 82
programme.desc: Fátima e Miguel se emocionam ao ver Salma agradando Fuad. Jendal anuncia a Chinua que está procurando uma nova esposa. Fortunato tem uma crise de ciúmes de Maria Helena. Tonho afirma a Niara que Jendal não se aproximará de Alika. Chinua revela a Kênia os novos planos de Jendal. Kênia garante a Chinua que não permitirá que Jendal a impeça de ser rainha de Batanga.

programme.title: A Próxima Vítima - Ep. 70

programme.desc: Agnes reconhece Serena como filha. Cristina confessa que jamais dormiu com Rafael. Guto pensa em como fugir da cadeia. Kátia provoca Felipe. Débora procura Dalila.

programme.title: Orgulho e Paixão - Ep. 92

Susana descobre que Olegário passou a noite com Briana. Briana enfrenta Lady Margareth e afirma que se casará com Olegário. Cecília sai para passear com Mariana. Lídia passa mal novamente e Ofélia deduz que a filha está grávida.

programme.title: Por Você - Ep. 1

programme.title: A Gata Comeu - Ep. 7

programme.title: Jornal Da Globo

programme.desc: Compreender os temas principais da Bíblia não tem de ser uma tarefa distante ou complexa.
